Review Questions • The total radiated power per unit volume is dW/(dt dV) = 1.42 × 10⁻²⁷ Z² n_i n_e T^{1/2} ḡ_B erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹ – Explain the physical dependence of the emissivity on each term.

Free-free Absorption • We have seen that the free-free emissivity is given by j_ν = (16πZ²e⁶ / 3√3 m_e²c³) n_i n_e (m_e/2πkT)^{1/2} ḡ_ff e^{−hν/kT} = 5.44 × 10⁻³⁹ Z² n_i n_e T^{−1/2} ḡ_ff e^{−hν/kT} erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹ sr⁻¹

• Electrons can also absorb radiation. • To find the related absorption coefficient, we can use Kirchhoff’s law κ_ν = j_ν/B_ν = (8πZ²e⁶ / 3√3 m_e²hc) n_i n_e (m_e/2πkT)^{1/2} ḡ_ff ν⁻³ (1 − e^{−hν/kT}) = 3.69 × 10⁸ Z² n_i n_e T^{−1/2} ḡ_ff ν⁻³ (1 − e^{−hν/kT}) cm⁻¹

Free-free Absorption • In the Rayleigh-Jeans limit (hν ≪ kT) valid for radio wavelengths, allowing for the dependence of the Gaunt factor on T, Z, and ν, the more accurate form of the emission and absorption coefficients can be written as j_ν ≈ 3.35 × 10⁻⁴⁰ Z^{1.882} n_i n_e T₄^{−0.323} ν₉^{−0.118} erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹ Hz⁻¹ sr⁻¹ ; κ_ν = j_ν/B_ν ≈ 3.37 × 10⁻⁷ Z^{1.882} n_i n_e T₄^{−1.323} ν₉^{−2.118} pc⁻¹
note: 검산: 3.35×10⁻⁴⁰·c²/(2k·10⁴·10¹⁸)·pc = 3.36×10⁻⁷ pc⁻¹ ✓. Gaunt=1 RJ값(5.5×10⁻⁸)의 ~6배 = 전파 Gaunt ≈ 6.

raw: • The optical depth (in the Rayleigh-Jeans limit) is then given by τ_ν = ∫κ_ν ds ≈ 3.37 × 10⁻⁷ Z^{1.882} T₄^{−1.323} ν₉^{−2.118} (n_i/n_p) [EM / cm⁻⁶pc] where EM ≡ ∫ n_e n_p ds is the emission measure; n_p = proton number density – Optically thick at low frequencies – Optically thin at high frequencies

Application • Consider an H II region filled with ionized hydrogen with temperature T, density n, and radius R, located at a distance d away from the Sun. [그림: 반지름 R인 노란 원(HII 영역)과 거리 d 떨어진 관측자 점으로 모이는 시선]

• Radiation transfer gives I_ν = S_ν(1 − e^{−τ_ν}). • At low frequency, the plasma is optically thick (τ_ν ≫ 1) and radiates like a black body since S_ν = j_ν/κ_ν = B_ν(T). Then the flux is F_ν = S_ν ΔΩ = B_ν π(R/d)² ∝ ν² (τ_ν ≫ 1, hν ≪ kT)
• At high frequency, the plasma is optically thin (τ_ν ≪ 1). Then, F_ν = (4πj_ν)(4πR³/3)(1/4πd²) = (4j_νR/3) π(R/d)² = (4κ_νR/3) B_ν π(R/d)² ∝ ν^{−0.1}

Application • Since I_ν = τ_ν S_ν in the optically-thin regime (τ_ν ≪ 1), one can write F_ν = B_ν τ̄_ν Ω_s, Ω_s = π(R/d)² – This gives the mean optical depth of the plasma in spherical shape τ̄_ν = (4κ_νR/3)

• Example spectrum : Orion nebula [그림: Orion 성운 전파 스펙트럼, 가로축 ν (MHz) 10¹–10⁴ 로그, 세로축 F_ν (Jy) 10¹–10³; 관측점(오차막대)과 모형 곡선 — 저주파 τ_ν ≫ 1 구간은 가파르게 상승, 고주파 τ_ν ≪ 1 구간은 거의 평탄하게 약간 감소; 꺾이는 곳에 화살표] The turn-over frequency corresponds to τ_ν = 1.

Q1 • The figure below shows two examples of thermal bremsstrahlung spectra, one from an H II region and the other from the hot intracluster medium (ICM). Can you identify which is which? [그림: 가로축 ν (Hz) 10⁷–10¹⁷, 세로축 (I_ν) 10⁻¹⁸–10⁻¹⁶ 로그. (A): 저주파에서 Planck(점선, ν²)를 따라 오르다 τ_ν ≪ 1 평탄 구간이 높게(~5×10⁻¹⁷) 이어진 뒤 ~10¹⁴–10¹⁵ Hz에서 급감. (B): 평탄 구간이 더 낮게(~1.6×10⁻¹⁷) 시작해 ~10¹⁷ Hz 근처까지 이어진 뒤 급감]
• Answer: (A) H II region, (B) ICM
Q2 • The parameters for spectrum (B) are n_i = n_e = 10⁻⁴ cm⁻³, T_e = 10⁶ K, Z = 1, and the path length of l = 1 Mpc. Calculate its EM.
• Answer: EM = 10⁻² [cm⁻⁶ pc]
